decision_record.transfer: Tensor 1W swing confluence edge is paid on a QQQ-down day within 5 sessions of the signal; capture requires the symbol itself to be trading at a current price - a halted/delisted name has no executable price at all.
decision_record.comparison: Entry evaluated on bars[-1] however old (pre-change) vs refusal when the symbol's last bar predates the 5-session signal window, on identical fires/bars; switch OFF restores the pre-change entry exactly.
decision_record.mechanism: Perception/execution: filters (cheap5/deep70) and sizing ran on the last available close with no staleness check - a name whose bars end 2026-09-25 still entered on 2026-10-23 at that ancient close (qty sized off a price that no longer exists).
decision_record.calculation: Fixture: fire dated 2026-10-23, symbol bars ending 2026-09-25 (20 sessions stale): control enters (cheap5 lane qty 250 @ $4.00; deep70 lane qty 166 @ $6.00); treatment refuses. Fresh bars (ending 2026-10-23) enter identically in both arms.
decision_record.experiment: Pre-registered A/B in tests/test_edge_batch25_blockers.py::TestQ07StaleBars. Rejection rule: OFF divergence, any treatment entry on bars older than the window, or any fresh-bar entry changed - revert. Forward paired rows in extra.q07_exp_journal.
